design_philosophy: NYT Magazine meets Stripe-quality engineering. Deep black backgrounds with copper/gold accents, generous whitespace, asymmetric editorial layouts, refined motion. Impressions of high culture (Dostoïevski, CNAM) mixed with deep technical rigor.

headings.styles: italic variants for emphasis and editorial tension

mono.usage: For technical details, tags, and BUT3 specific data

hierarchy_rules.labels: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-copper-400

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento 'Tetris' Grid for visual sections, asymmetrical. Standard 12-column logic but with irregular spans (e.g., col-span-5 and col-span-7).
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid border with subtle copper tint. Use border-collapse for technical grids.

surfaces.cards: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[rgba(197,131,43,0.15)] hover:border-[rgba(197,131,43,0.4)] transition-colors duration-300
surfaces.glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10 (for sticky nav)

buttons.primary: bg-[#C5832B] text-black hover:bg-[#E6C280] font-medium px-6 py-3 transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#E6C280] border border-[#C5832B] hover:bg-[rgba(197,131,43,0.1)] px-6 py-3 transition-all

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Smooth scrolling (Lenis strongly recommended if applicable, or CSS smooth scroll). Fade-in and slight translate-y-4 on scroll into view.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Text color shifts to copper_light. Cards slightly elevate (-translate-y-1) and borders glow.
motion_and_interactions.microinteractions: Animated 'En recherche d\'alternance' badge (pulsing dot or spinning border). Accordion for BUT3 section expands smoothly.

media_and_assets.hero_background: CSS generated very subtle grain/noise over deep black, maybe a very faint radial gradient in #C5832B at 5% opacity.

projects.usage: Project card for Miaam Flutter app
Project card for Voronoi colorful canvas

personal_life.usage: Présentation Personnelle grid - representing cultural interests
Présentation Personnelle grid - representing scientific curiosity

placeholders.portraits: DO NOT USE UNSPLASH FACES. Generate CSS/SVG stylized monograms (e.g., 'MD' in Playfair Display italic) inside an elegant border, or abstract geometric silhouettes using copper gradients for the 5 portraits in the bio carousel/grid.

media_and_assets.icons: lucide-react for UI interactions. Use thin stroke widths (1.5) to maintain editorial elegance.

components_strategy.navigation: Sticky top, glassmorphism, brand name 'Mouhammed Diop' in serif, links in sans-serif, primary CTA 'Contact'.
components_strategy.hero: Full screen (min-h-screen). Large serif statement. Badge: 'En recherche d\'alternance' with a pulsing status dot. 2 CTAs (View Projects, Download CV).
components_strategy.presentation: Bento grid mixing text (bio mentioning Dostoïevski, football, physics engine) with the 2 museum/globe photos and the 5 monogram placeholders.
components_strategy.timeline: Vertical line in muted copper. Timeline nodes are glowing copper dots. Date in mono font, title in serif.
components_strategy.projects_grid: 6 cards. 2 using provided screenshots, 4 using stylized text-based covers or dark copper gradients. 1px borders.
components_strategy.skills: 7 categories using a clean, border-collapse table-like grid or small pills with 1px border. No loud progress bars. Text-based elegance.
components_strategy.but3_portfolio: Shadcn Tabs or Accordion (highly customized to look editorial, dark backgrounds, copper active states). Must include a formal auto-evaluation table (use HTML table or grid) with strict borders.
components_strategy.testimonial: Large serif quote marks, italicized text, very generous padding. Center-aligned for tension against asymmetric sections.
components_strategy.contact: Shadcn form (Input, Textarea, Button). Raw HTML/Tailwind for the layout. Inputs must have bg-transparent and bottom borders ONLY (border-b), like elegant editorial forms.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure copper text against black meets 4.5:1 ratio. Use lighter copper (#E6C280) for smaller text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-projects', data-testid='contact-submit').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Playfair Display (via Google Fonts or similar) for headings and Outfit for body.
Set the Tailwind config to include the custom colors (copper variants).
Build the 'Présentation' section as a highly asymmetric grid. Use the provided CNAM and Globe URLs.
For the 5 portrait placeholders, create React components returning an SVG with a luxurious 'MD' monogram on a dark background with copper geometric lines.
The BUT3 Portfolio section MUST look academically serious but visually stunning. Use a highly customized Accordion/Tabs component.
The Contact form must feel like a premium magazine subscription form (bottom borders on inputs, no background fills).
Do NOT use pure purple or teal. Stick strictly to black, white, greys, and copper/gold.
